questions.question: On a default Mac laptop F1 is the brightness key, so terminal-focus users lose help entirely. Fix it, or accept it?

options.label: Add a global fallback key
options.description: Give help a second global binding that isn't a function key — e.g. Alt-h, matching the existing Alt-o for the file manager. Alt-modified letters aren't standard readline/agent bindings, so the PTY loses nothing. Works identically on all three OSes.

options.label: Accept it, document it
options.description: Leave F1 as the only terminal-focus route. Note the Fn+F1 / System Settings requirement in the README or help panel. Mac users on an external keyboard are unaffected.

options.label: Accept it silently
options.description: Change nothing. Mac laptop users press Esc to leave terminal focus, then '?', as they do today.

questions.question: explorer.exe with a URL is the least-verified leg and CI won't cover it. How do you want it handled?

options.label: Leave it, verify by hand
options.description: Keep explorer.exe. It works in practice and matches what the file manager already does. You or a Windows user confirms on the real binary before merge.

options.label: Use cmd /c start for URLs
options.description: Give the Windows URL path its own canonical launcher (cmd /c start "" <url>) instead of reusing explorer.exe, leaving the file-manager path untouched. More certain, slightly more code, and the empty-title argument is a known footgun to get right.
